decision: Develop the replacement by mixed-domain fine-tuning of YOLO-PCB; previous app models serve only as historical comparison artifacts.
status: Training compatibility probe passed; full accuracy-improving training not yet performed.

source.domains: PKU green-board imagery; external checkpoint training overlap unknown

training_proposal_not_validated_recipe.strategy: Fine-tune released checkpoint, initialize a new optimizer; do not resume original authors training schedule. Explicitly enable parameter gradients.
training_proposal_not_validated_recipe.domain_sampling: Equal source and target contribution per optimizer update; source replay includes missing hole. Do not let 3606 target images overwhelm 480 source full images.
training_proposal_not_validated_recipe.gpu_budget_policy: Measure Kaggle throughput and memory in pilot; adjust batch and maximum epochs to available free quota. No training duration guarantee.
training_proposal_not_validated_recipe.augmentation: Start with mild lighting and flips, without aggressive mosaic or heavy blur; compare validation losses and small-box recall.
training_proposal_not_validated_recipe.checkpoints: Atomic last checkpoint each epoch, optimizer/scheduler/scaler/RNG and metadata; persistent downloadable backups and tested fresh-session resume before long run.

data_actions: Audit source/target class semantics and image-label alignment before mixed packaging.
Resolve known duplicate/augmentation families before introducing a new split; existing target board independence is unknown.
Audit Mendeley PCB-Defect as possible independent five-class evaluation; missing pad must never be mapped to missing hole. Provider metadata verified, files not downloaded or audited.
Acquire and manually review real clean bare-PCB images; no all-clean false-positive benchmark currently exists.
Acquire independently sourced missing-hole examples before claiming six-class cross-domain accuracy.
evaluation: Keep source and target metrics separate; report per-class AP50, AP50-95, fixed operating-point precision/recall, and missed defect counts.
Select checkpoint with balanced domain/class performance, rather than aggregate score dominated by target data.
Select threshold on validation only; confidence 0.90 is not automatically valid after fine-tuning.
Retain an untouched final evaluation with independent acquisition/groups; existing development partitions cannot be relabeled as an untouched final test.
Measure false calls per clean board and probability of any false alarm per board.

provisional_acceptance_goals_not_promise.conditions: Report separately by domain and test protocol; change goals if evidence demonstrates infeasibility. No six-class real-domain claim without missing-hole coverage.
